luck.headline: Extra wins
luck.description: Actual matchup wins minus expected all-play wins. A positive number means the schedule helped.

historicalDna.scoringStrength: Within each completed season, team mean final PF per week divided by league mean final PF per week, minus one. Weighted mean of those league-relative strengths.
historicalDna.volatility: Within each completed season, population standard deviation of 14 regular-season final weekly PF divided by team mean PF. Weighted mean of season CVs.
historicalDna.classification: Use existing scoring quadrants, with weighted relative PF >= 0 for the above-league axis and weighted CV > scoring.quadrantCvBoundary for volatility.
historicalDna.availableWeights: Choose the latest up to three verified completed seasons for the same franchise and normalize available 50/30/20 weights to sum to 100%.
historicalDna.allTime: Equal-weight all verified completed seasons of the same franchise; observed quadrant persistence never recency-weighted.
historicalDna.activeSeason: Never blend ongoing 2026 data into Historical DNA; Current DNA remains separate.
historicalDna.franchiseContinuity: Explicit season + ESPN team slot mapping; 2023 ESPN slot 6 differs from 2024+.
